requirements.description: User wants the building preferably near public transport. Value set to the 75th percentile of mobility (70.93), rounded to 71.

The building is to be converted into a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is clearly necessary. Value set to the 75th percentile of education (75.14), rounded to 75.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 850.

The user asks for an energy class C or better, so buildings must be class A1 through C. The other requests (location in Turin, at least 850 sqm, capacity for 60 people, proximity to public transport, CDP/PNRR funding) do not map to the available energy columns and are not included.

output.explanation: Filters offices (property_type) with surface_area >= 850, energy class A1–C, within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the coordinates. The 60-person capacity was not among the extracted requirements, so it is not filtered.
